about.title: About Chao Xiong Trading
about.subtitle: Bridging the world with the finest Chinese tea culture.
about.body: Chao Xiong Trading Co., Ltd. is dedicated to bringing authentic Chinese tea and exquisite tea ware to tea lovers around the globe. Based in China, we work directly with historic tea gardens and skilled artisans to ensure every leaf and every pot meets the highest standards of quality. Whether you are a retailer, distributor, or tea enthusiast, we provide professional export services, reliable shipping, and a passion for tea culture.
